text:
deploy-bot: Deploy check failed for release/2026.03.21-rc3 — pausing promotion to prod. Reason: env-parity-check FAILED :exclamation:
deploy-bot: failing check -> config mismatch: `MODEL_VARIANT_SELECTOR` differs between staging and prod, and `FEATURE_FLAG_X` encoding mismatch detected.
anya.k: ugh, on call — what's the exact diff? :eyes:
samir: logs from preflight:
```
staging: MODEL_VARIANT_SELECTOR=variant-b
prod:    MODEL_VARIANT_SELECTOR=variant-a
staging: FEATURE_FLAG_X=true
prod:    FEATURE_FLAG_X=1  # parsed differently by runtime
```
maria: that `1` vs `true` is the root cause we've seen with the new runtime parser. it treats `1` as string not boolean, toggles variant selection logic.
darren: so prod will pick a smaller model (variant-a) while staging used variant-b — possible latency/cost regression if we force variant-b
anya.k: do we have customer-impacting behavior? any errors in logs?
samir: no errors but behavior change in routing metrics during canary. seen ~15% lower throughput on the canary pod due to fallback to variant-a when prefix matches.
ops-bot: Note: release window is 03/21 18:00-20:00 PT. This pause will push us outside the nominal window unless resolved quickly.
maria: quick options: 1) hotpatch prod config to normalize encoding (`FEATURE_FLAG_X=true`) 2) pin model variant in release to `variant-a` to match prod behavior 3) rollback the release to previous commit
anya.k: hotpatch sounds fastest but we need to update release notes and run a full preflight to be sure.
darren: +1 to hotpatch if we can confirm no other boolean-encoding mismatches. can someone run `./scripts/env-check --normalize` against prod config?
samir: running now... gives list of keys with encoding diffs:
```
FEATURE_FLAG_X: staging=true -> prod=1
MODEL_VARIANT_SELECTOR: staging=variant-b -> prod=variant-a
CACHE_ENABLED: staging=true -> prod=true
```
anya.k: ok, small set. maria, can you push a config hotpatch and run a canary redeploy?
maria: yes, I'll prepare a patch:
```
kubectl set env deployment/runtime FEATURE_FLAG_X=true --namespace=prod
# then trigger canary redeploy: ./deploy canary --revision=release/2026.03.21-rc3
```
maria: will also update release notes: `Fix: normalize FEATURE_FLAG_X encoding across envs to prevent model-variant drift`
darren: if hotpatch succeeds, we still should pin model variant in the release manifest to prevent future autodetection drift. add `MODEL_VARIANT_SELECTOR=variant-b` to release container env.
anya.k: agree — do both. track in release notes and add a follow-up ticket to sweep boolean encoding across infra.
ops-bot: scheduling follow-up ticket in backlog: INFRA-7893
samir: can we also add a `preflight` lint to catch `1` vs `true` booleans? i can add a rule to deploy-check
maria: starting hotpatch now, will post status.
maria: hotpatch applied, triggering canary... :rocket:
maria: canary rolled, health OK, metrics stable after variant normalization (latency back to expected).
anya.k: nice. proceed with rollout, but leave the deploy paused until we pin variant in manifest and update release notes.
darren: I'll prepare a quick PR to pin variant and add the change notes.
anya.k: ping me when PR merges, then we unpause.
maria: PR opened: github.com/redwood/release/PR-612
samir: preflight check re-run looks clean.
deploy-bot: Release check cleared after manual intervention. Unpause request pending from channel.
anya.k: approving unpause. Go ahead and resume deployment when PR merges. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: record this in post-release notes and schedule a config parity audit next week.
